_comment: The only place that decides which MTProto server this client talks to. Edit this file, then run: python3 Tellomi/generate_server_config.py. See docs/TELLOMI.md. Defaults match a local Teamgram docker deployment: gnetway TCP published on port 10443, datacenter id 1, and the development RSA key that teamgram-server ships (teamgramd/bin/server_pkcs1.key, gnetway.yaml KeyFingerprint 12240908862933197005). 127.0.0.1 reaches that port from the iOS Simulator, which shares the Mac's network. A physical device needs the host's LAN address instead. Do not commit a private key.
